title: Live computer turn test in production and staging
description:
Computer images are promoted for staging and production, but no turn has yet escalated to the computer in either environment.

Staging is blocked by chatticus-99cae9 (integration principal). Production has no integration principal by repo rule, so it needs a real signed-in test by the owner.

Feature: Live computer turn
  Scenario: A turn escalates to the computer
    Given the environment has the promoted computer image
    When a signed-in user sends a message whose turn first needs the computer
    Then the computer starts from the environment image and the turn completes
right_now_summary: Staging is blocked, and production still needs a real signed-in test of the computer turn.
